skills.name: Persona: Palladion
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. Persona - Palladion: This effect is continuous and cannot be removed. Function: Aigis strengthens herself using her Persona. Effect 1: Tarukaja: ATK ▲ 12.48% continuously. This effect cannot be removed. Effect 2: Rakukaja: DEF ▲ 12.48% continuously. This effect cannot be removed.

skills.name: Papillon Heart
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when using Burst Skill as long as this unit is still alive. Papillon Heart: This effect is continuous and cannot be removed. Function: Aigis strengthens her allies. Effect 1: Affects all allies. Matarukaja: ATK ▲ 12.48% of the skill user's ATK continuously. This effect cannot be removed. Effect 2: Affects all allies. Marakukaja: DEF ▲ 12.48% of the skill user's DEF continuously. This effect cannot be removed. Deactivation condition: When Full Burst ends.

skills.name: Heat Wave
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects all enemies. Deals 234% of final ATK as distributed damage.
